description: This file defines a Python class 'Fertilizer' that inherits from frappe.model.document.Document, representing a Fertilizer document type in the ERPNext system. It includes a method 'load_contents' to fetch related 'Agriculture Analysis Criteria' documents linked to 'Fertilizer' and appends their titles to the fertilizer_contents child table.

classes.name: Fertilizer
classes.description: A document class representing Fertilizer data, with method to load related analysis criteria.

methods.name: load_contents(self)
methods.description: Fetches all 'Agriculture Analysis Criteria' linked to Fertilizer and appends their titles to the fertilizer_contents attribute.
